en.text: Hezekiah began to reign when he was twenty-five years old, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

zhSimplified.text: 希西家登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他母亲名叫亚比雅，是撒迦利雅的女儿。

zhTraditional.text: 希西家登基的時候年二十五歲，在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他母親名叫亞比雅，是撒迦利雅的女兒。

en.text: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, according to all that David his father had done.

zhSimplified.text: 希西家行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他祖大卫一切所行的。

zhTraditional.text: 希西家行耶和華眼中看為正的事，效法他祖大衛一切所行的。

en.text: In the first year of his reign, in the first month, he opened the doors of the LORD’s house and repaired them.

zhSimplified.text: 元年正月，开了耶和华殿的门，重新修理。

zhTraditional.text: 元年正月，開了耶和華殿的門，重新修理。

en.text: He brought in the priests and the Levites and gathered them together into the wide place on the east,

zhSimplified.text: 他召众祭司和利未人来，聚集在东边的宽阔处，

zhTraditional.text: 他召眾祭司和利未人來，聚集在東邊的寬闊處，

en.text: and said to them, “Listen to me, you Levites! Now sanctify yourselves, and sanctify the house of the LORD, the God of your fathers, and carry the filthiness out of the holy place.

zhSimplified.text: 对他们说：「利未人哪，当听我说：现在你们要洁净自己，又洁净耶和华—你们列祖 神的殿，从圣所中除去污秽之物。

zhTraditional.text: 對他們說：「利未人哪，當聽我說：現在你們要潔淨自己，又潔淨耶和華－你們列祖上帝的殿，從聖所中除去污穢之物。

en.text: For our fathers were unfaithful, and have done that which was evil in the LORD our God’s sight, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the LORD, and turned their backs.

zhSimplified.text: 我们列祖犯了罪，行耶和华—我们 神眼中看为恶的事，离弃他，转脸背向他的居所，

zhTraditional.text: 我們列祖犯了罪，行耶和華－我們上帝眼中看為惡的事，離棄他，轉臉背向他的居所，

en.text: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place to the God of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 封锁廊门，吹灭灯火，不在圣所中向以色列 神烧香，或献燔祭。

zhTraditional.text: 封鎖廊門，吹滅燈火，不在聖所中向以色列上帝燒香，或獻燔祭。

en.text: Therefore the LORD’s wrath was on Judah and Jerusalem, and he has delivered them to be tossed back and forth, to be an astonishment and a hissing, as you see with your eyes.

zhSimplified.text: 因此，耶和华的忿怒临到犹大和耶路撒冷，将其中的人抛来抛去，令人惊骇、嗤笑，正如你们亲眼所见的。

zhTraditional.text: 因此，耶和華的忿怒臨到猶大和耶路撒冷，將其中的人拋來拋去，令人驚駭、嗤笑，正如你們親眼所見的。

en.text: For behold, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.

zhSimplified.text: 所以我们的祖宗倒在刀下，我们的妻子儿女也被掳掠。

zhTraditional.text: 所以我們的祖宗倒在刀下，我們的妻子兒女也被擄掠。

en.text: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with the LORD, the God of Israel, that his fierce anger may turn away from us.

zhSimplified.text: 现在我心中有意与耶和华—以色列的 神立约，好使他的烈怒转离我们。

zhTraditional.text: 現在我心中有意與耶和華－以色列的上帝立約，好使他的烈怒轉離我們。

en.text: My sons, don’t be negligent now; for the LORD has chosen you to stand before him, to minister to him, and that you should be his ministers and burn incense.”

zhSimplified.text: 我的众子啊，现在不要懈怠；因为耶和华拣选你们站在他面前事奉他，与他烧香。」

zhTraditional.text: 我的眾子啊，現在不要懈怠；因為耶和華揀選你們站在他面前事奉他，與他燒香。」

en.text: Then the Levites arose: Mahath, the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites; and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehallelel; and of the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah;

zhSimplified.text: 于是，利未人哥辖的子孙、亚玛赛的儿子玛哈，亚撒利雅的儿子约珥；米拉利的子孙、亚伯底的儿子基士，耶哈利勒的儿子亚撒利雅；革顺的子孙、薪玛的儿子约亚，约亚的儿子伊甸；

zhTraditional.text: 於是，利未人哥轄的子孫、亞瑪賽的兒子瑪哈，亞撒利雅的兒子約珥；米拉利的子孫、亞伯底的兒子基士，耶哈利勒的兒子亞撒利雅；革順的子孫、薪瑪的兒子約亞，約亞的兒子伊甸；

en.text: and of the sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeuel; and of the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;

zhSimplified.text: 以利撒反的子孙申利和耶利；亚萨的子孙撒迦利雅和玛探雅；

zhTraditional.text: 以利撒反的子孫申利和耶利；亞薩的子孫撒迦利雅和瑪探雅；

en.text: and of the sons of Heman, Jehuel and Shimei; and of the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.

zhSimplified.text: 希幔的子孙耶歇和示每；耶杜顿的子孙示玛雅和乌薛；

zhTraditional.text: 希幔的子孫耶歇和示每；耶杜頓的子孫示瑪雅和烏薛；

en.text: They gathered their brothers, sanctified themselves, and went in, according to the commandment of the king by the LORD’s words, to cleanse the LORD’s house.

zhSimplified.text: 起来聚集他们的弟兄，洁净自己，照着王的吩咐、耶和华的命令，进去洁净耶和华的殿。

zhTraditional.text: 起來聚集他們的弟兄，潔淨自己，照着王的吩咐、耶和華的命令，進去潔淨耶和華的殿。

en.text: The priests went into the inner part of the LORD’s house to cleanse it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the LORD’s temple into the court of the LORD’s house. The Levites took it from there to carry it out to the brook Kidron.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司进入耶和华的殿要洁净殿，将殿中所有污秽之物搬到耶和华殿的院内，利未人接去，搬到外头汲沦溪边。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司進入耶和華的殿要潔淨殿，將殿中所有污穢之物搬到耶和華殿的院內，利未人接去，搬到外頭汲淪溪邊。

en.text: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month they came to the LORD’s porch. They sanctified the LORD’s house in eight days, and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.

zhSimplified.text: 从正月初一日洁净起，初八日到了耶和华的殿廊，用八日的工夫洁净耶和华的殿，到正月十六日才洁净完了。

zhTraditional.text: 從正月初一日潔淨起，初八日到了耶和華的殿廊，用八日的工夫潔淨耶和華的殿，到正月十六日才潔淨完了。

en.text: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king within the palace and said, “We have cleansed all the LORD’s house, including the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, and the table of show bread with all its vessels.

zhSimplified.text: 于是，他们晋见希西家王，说：「我们已将耶和华的全殿和燔祭坛，并坛的一切器皿、陈设饼的桌子，与桌子的一切器皿都洁净了；

zhTraditional.text: 於是，他們晉見希西家王，說：「我們已將耶和華的全殿和燔祭壇，並壇的一切器皿、陳設餅的桌子，與桌子的一切器皿都潔淨了；

en.text: Moreover, we have prepared and sanctified all the vessels which King Ahaz threw away in his reign when he was unfaithful. Behold, they are before the LORD’s altar.”

zhSimplified.text: 并且亚哈斯王在位犯罪的时候所废弃的器皿，我们预备齐全，且洁净了，现今都在耶和华的坛前。」

zhTraditional.text: 並且亞哈斯王在位犯罪的時候所廢棄的器皿，我們預備齊全，且潔淨了，現今都在耶和華的壇前。」

en.text: Then Hezekiah the king arose early, gathered the princes of the city, and went up to the LORD’s house.

zhSimplified.text: 希西家王清早起来，聚集城里的首领都上耶和华的殿；

zhTraditional.text: 希西家王清早起來，聚集城裏的首領都上耶和華的殿；

en.text: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary, and for Judah. He commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on the LORD’s altar.

zhSimplified.text: 牵了七只公牛，七只公羊，七只羊羔，七只公山羊，要为国、为殿、为犹大人作赎罪祭。王吩咐亚伦的子孙众祭司，献在耶和华的坛上，

zhTraditional.text: 牽了七隻公牛，七隻公羊，七隻羊羔，七隻公山羊，要為國、為殿、為猶大人作贖罪祭。王吩咐亞倫的子孫眾祭司，獻在耶和華的壇上，

en.text: So they killed the bulls, and the priests received the blood and sprinkled it on the altar. They killed the rams and sprinkled the blood on the altar. They also killed the lambs and sprinkled the blood on the altar.

zhSimplified.text: 就宰了公牛，祭司接血洒在坛上，宰了公羊，把血洒在坛上，又宰了羊羔，也把血洒在坛上；

zhTraditional.text: 就宰了公牛，祭司接血灑在壇上，宰了公羊，把血灑在壇上，又宰了羊羔，也把血灑在壇上；

en.text: They brought near the male goats for the sin offering before the king and the assembly; and they laid their hands on them.

zhSimplified.text: 把那作赎罪祭的公山羊牵到王和会众面前，他们就按手在其上。

zhTraditional.text: 把那作贖罪祭的公山羊牽到王和會眾面前，他們就按手在其上。

en.text: Then the priests killed them, and they made a sin offering with their blood on the altar, to make atonement for all Israel; for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司宰了羊，将血献在坛上作赎罪祭，为以色列众人赎罪，因为王吩咐将燔祭和赎罪祭为以色列众人献上。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司宰了羊，將血獻在壇上作贖罪祭，為以色列眾人贖罪，因為王吩咐將燔祭和贖罪祭為以色列眾人獻上。

en.text: He set the Levites in the LORD’s house with cymbals, with stringed instruments, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, of Gad the king’s seer, and Nathan the prophet; for the commandment was from the LORD by his prophets.

zhSimplified.text: 王又派利未人在耶和华殿中敲钹，鼓瑟，弹琴，乃照大卫和他先见迦得，并先知拿单所吩咐的，就是耶和华借先知所吩咐的。

zhTraditional.text: 王又派利未人在耶和華殿中敲鈸，鼓瑟，彈琴，乃照大衛和他先見迦得，並先知拿單所吩咐的，就是耶和華藉先知所吩咐的。

en.text: The Levites stood with David’s instruments, and the priests with the trumpets.

zhSimplified.text: 利未人拿大卫的乐器，祭司拿号，一同站立。

zhTraditional.text: 利未人拿大衛的樂器，祭司拿號，一同站立。

en.text: Hezekiah commanded them to offer the burnt offering on the altar. When the burnt offering began, the LORD’s song also began, along with the trumpets and instruments of David king of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 希西家吩咐在坛上献燔祭，燔祭一献，就唱赞美耶和华的歌，用号，并用以色列王大卫的乐器相和。

zhTraditional.text: 希西家吩咐在壇上獻燔祭，燔祭一獻，就唱讚美耶和華的歌，用號，並用以色列王大衛的樂器相和。

en.text: All the assembly worshiped, the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded. All this continued until the burnt offering was finished.

zhSimplified.text: 会众都敬拜，歌唱的歌唱，吹号的吹号，如此直到燔祭献完了。

zhTraditional.text: 會眾都敬拜，歌唱的歌唱，吹號的吹號，如此直到燔祭獻完了。

en.text: When they had finished offering, the king and all who were present with him bowed themselves and worshiped.

zhSimplified.text: 献完了祭，王和一切跟随的人都俯伏敬拜。

zhTraditional.text: 獻完了祭，王和一切跟隨的人都俯伏敬拜。

en.text: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praises to the LORD with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. They sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshiped.

zhSimplified.text: 希西家王与众首领又吩咐利未人用大卫和先见亚萨的诗词颂赞耶和华；他们就欢欢喜喜地颂赞耶和华，低头敬拜。

zhTraditional.text: 希西家王與眾首領又吩咐利未人用大衛和先見亞薩的詩詞頌讚耶和華；他們就歡歡喜喜地頌讚耶和華，低頭敬拜。

en.text: Then Hezekiah answered, “Now you have consecrated yourselves to the LORD. Come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the LORD’s house.” The assembly brought in sacrifices and thank offerings, and as many as were of a willing heart brought burnt offerings.

zhSimplified.text: 希西家说：「你们既然归耶和华为圣，就要前来把祭物和感谢祭奉到耶和华殿里。」会众就把祭物和感谢祭奉来，凡甘心乐意的也将燔祭奉来。

zhTraditional.text: 希西家說：「你們既然歸耶和華為聖，就要前來把祭物和感謝祭奉到耶和華殿裏。」會眾就把祭物和感謝祭奉來，凡甘心樂意的也將燔祭奉來。

en.text: The number of the burnt offerings which the assembly brought was seventy bulls, one hundred rams, and two hundred lambs. All these were for a burnt offering to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 会众所奉的燔祭如下：公牛七十只，公羊一百只，羊羔二百只，这都是作燔祭献给耶和华的；

zhTraditional.text: 會眾所奉的燔祭如下：公牛七十隻，公羊一百隻，羊羔二百隻，這都是作燔祭獻給耶和華的；

en.text: The consecrated things were six hundred head of cattle and three thousand sheep.

zhSimplified.text: 又有分别为圣之物，公牛六百只，绵羊三千只。

zhTraditional.text: 又有分別為聖之物，公牛六百隻，綿羊三千隻。

en.text: But the priests were too few, so that they could not skin all the burnt offerings. Therefore their brothers the Levites helped them until the work was ended, and until the priests had sanctified themselves, for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.

zhSimplified.text: 但祭司太少，不能剥尽燔祭牲的皮，所以他们的弟兄利未人帮助他们，直等燔祭的事完了，又等别的祭司自洁了；因为利未人诚心自洁，胜过祭司。

zhTraditional.text: 但祭司太少，不能剝盡燔祭牲的皮，所以他們的弟兄利未人幫助他們，直等燔祭的事完了，又等別的祭司自潔了；因為利未人誠心自潔，勝過祭司。

en.text: Also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings and with the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of the LORD’s house was set in order.

zhSimplified.text: 燔祭和平安祭牲的脂油，并燔祭同献的奠祭甚多。这样，耶和华殿中的事务俱都齐备了。

zhTraditional.text: 燔祭和平安祭牲的脂油，並燔祭同獻的奠祭甚多。這樣，耶和華殿中的事務俱都齊備了。

en.text: Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced because of that which God had prepared for the people; for the thing was done suddenly.

zhSimplified.text: 这事办的甚速，希西家和众民都喜乐，是因 神为众民所预备的。

zhTraditional.text: 這事辦的甚速，希西家和眾民都喜樂，是因上帝為眾民所預備的。
